metadata.title: Arithmeticity, superrigidity, and totally geodesic submanifolds of infinite-volume hyperbolic manifolds
metadata.abstract: Given an infinite-volume convex cocompact hyperbolic manifold with Fuchsian ends and infinitely many maximal properly immersed totally geodesic submanifolds of dimension at least two intersecting its convex core, we show that it (infinitely) covers an arithmetic hyperbolic manifold. This answers the general version of a question of Oh. As a byproduct of our techniques, we also give a Ratner-type classification of $\mathrm{SO}_0(m,1)$-invariant Radon measures whose support intersects the frame bundle of the interior of the convex core.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 无限体积双曲流形的算术性
analysis.workSummary: 对具 Fuchsian ends 的无限体积凸余紧双曲流形，在有无穷多个与凸核相交的最大适当浸入全测地子流形且维数至少二时，证明它无限覆盖某个算术双曲流形，并分类相应 SO0(m,1) 不变 Radon 测度。
analysis.breakthrough: 回答 Oh 的一般形式问题，将无限体积几何的丰度转化为算术来源。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方摘要和作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读完整证明。Fuchsian ends、凸余紧与最大子流形条件不可省略；测度分类也限于支撑穿过凸核内部标架丛。 AI 披露另见独立全文核查。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确披露第 5 节若干想法在与大语言模型的对话中发展；引言说明该节通过边界测度及熵关系获取后续 Ratner 论证所需的额外不变性。另披露文献检索、校对、制图及证明检查。记录所指研究路线和辅助用途，不补写未说明的模型名称。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23594v1 · PDF 第 6 页，AI Disclosure；第 4 页对第 5 节作用的说明
